queries.projects: SELECT code AS name FROM project ORDER BY code
queries.platforms: SELECT pl.code AS name FROM platform pl JOIN project pr ON pr.id = pl.project_id WHERE pr.code = :project ORDER BY pl.code
queries.versions: SELECT r.release_no AS version, r.in_service AS effective FROM system_release r JOIN platform pl ON pl.id = r.platform_id JOIN project pr ON pr.id = pl.project_id WHERE pr.code = :project AND pl.code = :platform ORDER BY r.release_no DESC
queries.software_units: SELECT c.component_name AS name, c.component_version AS version, c.repository AS source_name FROM release_component c JOIN system_release r ON r.id = c.system_release_id JOIN platform pl ON pl.id = r.platform_id JOIN project pr ON pr.id = pl.project_id WHERE pr.code = :project AND pl.code = :platform AND r.release_no = :version ORDER BY c.component_name
